title: Champion of Andia
description:
The Empire seeks a Champion to defend against enemy assaults, safeguard their people, fortify alliances, and eventually take the battle to their foes' lands. With experience and gold, could you rise to become the Champion they need?

Champion of Andia is an Action RPG Arena Fighter set in a medieval fantasy realm. Create your character and combat waves of foes with directional melee combat and magic! Earn XP and gold through missions to upgrade your stats and gear. Play solo or cooperatively with friends, or challenge them in Team v Team & FFA battles! Engage in dynamic combat with magic and abilities! 

• Create a champion for 5 diverse fantasy races!

• Dive into Singleplayer or Cooperative gameplay with friends! Or dive into heart-pounding Team v Team battles!

• Engage in dynamic combat with a directional melee system

• Unleash a variety of spells and abilities to dominate the battlefield

• Progress through a rewarding level-up system, enhancing your champion's skills 

• Access a vast array of over 200 unique weapons and armor assets to customize your champion's arsenal 

CoA is currently in early access and created by a solo developer (me!). I am actively seeking feedback to improve the game. Stay tuned for upcoming additions including more missions, enemy variety, maps, game modes, and an expanded arsenal of weapons and armor. Your input is invaluable in shaping the future of CoA!

Champion of Andia is currently designed for Windows only. It is not compatible with Mac or other operating systems.
description_short: Step into a dynamic Action RPG Arena Fighter set in a medieval fantasy realm. Create your champion, battle waves of enemies and level up with friends in solo or cooperative play. Earn gold for powerful gear and powerups!
